data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a small prior-year reserve strengthening of $0.885m in 2024. This movement reflected ex-catastrophe strengthening on older years, notably within Professional Lines and discontinued portfolios, partially offset by favourable movements on several historic catastrophe events. Overall the impact on the combined ratio was limited.

data.data_quality_notes: All monetary figures are reported in the report's native currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) claims outstanding (prior year comparative). Prior year development taken from the Managing Agent narrative which explicitly states a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $885k. Claims development triangle is present in the report (pages ~52-53) but detailed cell-by-cell extraction was not fully parsed with high confidence; triangle exists in $'000 units. LOB movement amounts are not disaggregated by amount in the narrative; directions are inferred from wording (confidence 0.5).

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development triangle is printed in the report (see pages 52-53). The table is in $'000 and includes an aggregate '2014 & prior' column which has been excluded from the underwriting_years. Detailed extraction of each development cell was not completed with high certainty for every cell, so development_rows left empty; refer to the report pages for the full triangle.
